name: openaq-mcp-server
description: Find air-quality monitoring stations, read latest sensor values, and pull historical pollutant series via MCP. STDIO or Streamable HTTP.

OPENAQ_API_KEY.title: OpenAQ API key
OPENAQ_API_KEY.description: OpenAQ v3 API key, sent as the X-API-Key header on every request. Required — OpenAQ v3 rejects unauthenticated calls. Free from an OpenAQ Explorer account at explore.openaq.org.
